title: AgentPlane signed audit checkpoint
description: Signed checkpoint for one tenant chain, kept in a store separate from the audit database (ADR-006 section 7). The signature metadata (alg, key_id) is inside the signed payload; the envelope carries only the payload and the signature. Phase 0 defines the format only: no signer, key management, publication or store exists.

count.description: Number of chain entries (events, not requests). The head index is count - 1.

head_hash.description: record_hash of index count - 1, or the genesis hash when count is 0.

alg.description: Signature algorithm. Only Ed25519 is defined in version 1; the algorithm is authoritative in the trusted key registry, this field must match it.

sig.description: Base64 (standard alphabet, padded) Ed25519 signature, 64 bytes, over the canonical signed bytes.
